prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE square transparent Minecraft Java ore overlay authored in large logical 16x16 pixels.
Primary request: Tin Quartz FRAGMENT independent variant 1, a substantial but SHORT dirty-gray quartz-cassiterite fissure filling. Draw two physically touching staggered thick segments: a lower 3-cell-thick blocky gray pocket and a narrower upper segment shifted one cell to the side, with a transparent notch at their joint. One sparse dark cassiterite cluster sits inside. This is a local greisen fissure window, not a gem or full vein.
Scene/backdrop: genuine fully clear RGBA alpha outside mineral, no stone, matte or checkerboard.
Style/medium: opaque hard-edged square logical pixels about 1/16 canvas, no subpixel detail.
Composition/framing: Connected mineral body occupies roughly 5–6 logical cells in total height and 2–3 cells width locally, about 16–22 visible center-sampled cells. At least 10 visible and 6 connected. Keep the whole formation compact and off-center with large clear alpha. No edge contact required, no full-height vertical slash. Different from retained0 and sibling2 by its compact staggered pocket-and-neck structure.
Materials/textures: medium dirty gray quartz shades roughly #777673 to #8b8985, a few slightly paler MID-GRAY interior cells, dark cassiterite entirely internal. Absolutely no white/off-white, black outline or pale rail.
Constraints: exactly one square PNG >=1024x1024, true transparent alpha, mineral-only original untouched, no frame/text.
Avoid: 1–6-cell wisp, huge bright slash, smooth gradients, glow, antialiasing, haze.
